title: Marketing positioning for Zenno AI booking

state.product: Zenno: booking software for appointment businesses (salons, barbers, beauty, wellness). Every salon page on Zenno now carries machine-readable data for AI search (services, prices, hours, a 'book directly' action), an llms.txt, and a plain AI booking form so an AI assistant can complete the booking itself — no customer account, no redirect. Owners switch it on with one toggle, choose auto-accept or approve each, get an email per AI booking, and see a dashboard card 'Where your bookings come from' that counts AI bookings and AI referrals.

market.demand: 45% of US consumers used AI to find local businesses in 2026, up from 6% in 2025; ChatGPT most used at 31%.
market.platforms: Google AI Mode books local appointments through partner platforms (US first, summer 2026). OpenAI retired in-chat checkout in March 2026: discover in AI, complete on the business's own site.
market.germany: None of these platform launches cover Germany yet. Zenno's first city is Hamburg.

competitors.fresha: Aug 2026: bookings via ChatGPT and Claude for its 140,000-business marketplace; the AI finds the slot, then sends the customer to Fresha to confirm and pay.
competitors.treatwell: Largest marketplace in Germany; 35% commission on a new customer's first booking plus monthly fee.
competitors.planity: Growing in Germany since 2024; subscription, no commission; no AI booking announced.

state.honest_limits: No real ChatGPT or Google agent booking has been observed yet on a Zenno page; Zenno is not listed as a ChatGPT app; agent identity verification not built yet; admin UI is English only.
state.buyer: Owner of an independent salon in Hamburg, often older and non-technical, busy with clients, sceptical of marketplaces and commissions.

category.instructions: Which category name should marketing use for this product?

criteria.ai_bookable_salon: 'The salon AI can book' — describes the outcome for the owner, not the technology.
criteria.booking_layer_for_ai_search: 'The booking layer for AI search' — infrastructure framing.
criteria.ai_booking_software: 'AI booking software for salons' — plain software category.

lead_promise.instructions: Which promise should lead the headline for the buyer in `state.buyer`?

criteria.get_booked_not_just_found: Get booked by AI, not just found: when customers ask ChatGPT or Google, your salon is the one that can be booked on the spot.
criteria.your_customers_no_commission: Bookings from AI land in your own calendar, under your own name, with no marketplace commission.
criteria.early_in_hamburg: Be first in Hamburg: AI booking reaches Germany soon; be ready before your competitors.

lead_differentiator_vs_marketplaces.instructions: Against Fresha and Treatwell, which differentiator should marketing lead with?

criteria.own_page_no_middleman: The booking happens on your own page and brand, not a marketplace that owns the customer relationship.
criteria.no_commission: No commission on AI bookings, unlike 35% first-booking commission on Treatwell.
criteria.works_with_every_ai: Open web standards, so it works with any AI that reads the web, not one app store listing.

primary_segment.instructions: Which segment should the first campaign target?

criteria.existing_zenno_salons: Existing Zenno salons: switch AI booking on, prove it works, collect first case studies.
criteria.treatwell_salons_hamburg: Hamburg salons currently paying Treatwell commissions.
criteria.salons_without_online_booking: Hamburg salons with no online booking at all.
